title: Handoff Receipt
description: The immutable record of an outcome, minted in the same transaction as the state transition. A request has at most one decision receipt (I1). Receipts are never updated; a correction is a new receipt (I2).

kind.description: `policy` records an outcome reached without a person. `correction` supersedes an earlier receipt without editing it; both remain in the chain.

corrects.description: REQUIRED when kind is `correction`, null otherwise.

decided_at.description: Server clock. A server MUST NOT accept a client-supplied decision time.

request_version.description: The version of the request this person decided on, not the request's latest version.

request_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonicalized request at `request_version`.

rendered.description: What the person actually saw. Computed at presentation time and retained; a server MUST NOT re-derive it later from the request's current content.

binding.description: Which presentation-binding mode applied at answer time.

diverged.description: True when the answerer's echoed digest did not match under `advisory` binding. Under `strict` the answer would have been rejected with 409 presentation_stale.

via.description: The delivery through which the answer arrived. Null for a policy receipt.

grade_reached.description: `dispatched` means our transport accepted it — it is not evidence a person received anything.

endorsements.description: Every principal that contributed to quorum, each with the moment it endorsed.

oneOf.description: A policy receipt satisfied no authority.

steps.description: The progressive-disclosure ladder, recorded as one intervention with one decision.

secret_fields.description: Names only. Values never appear here, or anywhere else (I7).

waiter_state_at_decision.description: Records that an answer arrived after the requester was already gone.

then.description: A policy receipt MUST name the policy as the actor so that no audit mistakes it for consent.

values.description: The typed answer. A field declared `secret` appears here ONLY as {"provided": true}; the value itself never enters a receipt (I7).

disposition.description: `delegate` and `unable` are dispositions, not states. Neither settles the request on its own.

effective.description: Present on a policy receipt: what the unanswered request resolved to.

Actor.description: A record that cannot say who decided is not a receipt. A server MUST NOT record type `user` unless it authenticated a person.

type.description: `runtime` records a machine observation credited as such; it never stands in for a person (I16). `anonymous_link` records that only a delivery token was held.

role_at_decision.description: Snapshot: the role held at the moment of the decision, not the role held now.

ip_digest.description: Salted digest. Enough to correlate a disputed session, not a surveillance record.

on_behalf_of.description: On a requester actor: the person the machine acted for. Null means genuinely autonomous work, and MUST read as such rather than as an unattributed blank.

CapabilityUse.description: Presence and effect, never content. Input payloads, keystrokes, and form values MUST NOT be recorded.

navigations.description: Ordered origins visited during the session. Origin granularity by default; full URLs only behind an explicit deployment policy.

resource_digest.description: Digest of the provider resource reference — proves which resource without publishing provider internals.

Clearance.description: How the completion of an out-of-band act was established. Clearance is asserted, never inferred (I16).

runtime_observation.description: What the runtime observed on resume. Where it disagrees with the human assertion, both are recorded.

then.description: The protocol never fabricates a person.

ChainEntry.description: Per-tenant hash chain. See signing.md §2.2 for the exact canonicalization and worked vectors.

height.description: 0-based position in this tenant's chain. Binding it prevents an entry being excised and the rest re-linked.

prev_digest.description: 64 zeros for the first receipt in a tenant.
